_source: Figure-eight three-body choreography (Chenciner and Montgomery 2000; initial conditions from Simo 2002 / Suvakov and Dmitrasinovic 2013, G=1, m=1), lengths scaled by 2 and speeds by 1/sqrt(2) so bodies start at least 1.0 apart. The domain's softening 0.3 destroys the exact choreography; it is a stress input, not a reproduction of the published orbit.
